assessment_objectives.objective: performance and capacity planning includes resiliency planning for alternate storage and/or processing sites.

the capacity required for alternate storage and/or processing sites to run production operations throughout the duration of Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) operations is determined and documented.
alternate storage and/or processing sites are provisioned with, or contractually guaranteed, capacity that meets the documented requirements.
the frequency at which to review alternate site capacity requirements is defined.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least annually, and upon significant change

assessment_objectives.objective: alternate site capacity requirements are reviewed and updated at the defined frequency and when production workloads change significantly.
